<reason>CON won a close, high-quality clash by making irreversibility the decision rule and then winning it: the ban, not a maintained foreign tool base, is what creates a captive domestic order book. PRO never named the delay it treated as the product, and CON’s dilemma—if the frontier matters, do not build their ladder; if it does not, the ban buys little—was the cleaner vote path. PRO’s factory-cannot-be-recalled case stayed powerful but did not neutralize servicing-as-lever or the dual-use order-book argument.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s Rebuttal 2 (A4): answering PRO’s pressure by layering current vs future military use, then flipping irreversibility so the ban, not the shipment, is the step that cannot be recalled.</best_rebuttal>
